segments.ja438:1.1: Yo te puttake akhādi, dinnabhatto adūsake;
segments.ja438:1.3: Tasmiṃ dāṭhaṃ nipātehi, mā te muccittha jīvato.
segments.ja438:2.3: Padesaṃ taṃ na passāmi, yattha dāṭhaṃ nipātaye.
segments.ja438:3.3: Sabbaṃ ce pathaviṃ dajjā, neva naṃ abhirādhaye.
segments.ja438:4.1: Kinnu subāhu taramānarūpo, paccāgatosi saha māṇavena;
segments.ja438:4.3: Kiṃ kiccamatthaṃ idhamatthi tuyhaṃ, akkhāhi me pucchito etamatthaṃ.
segments.ja438:5.1: Yo te sakhā daddaro sādhurūpo, tassa vadhaṃ parisaṅkāmi ajja;
segments.ja438:5.3: Purisassa kammāyatanāni sutvā, nāhaṃ sukhiṃ daddaraṃ ajja maññe.
segments.ja438:6.3: Kaṃ vā paṭiññaṃ purisassa sutvā, parisaṅkasi daddaraṃ māṇavena.
segments.ja438:7.1: Ciṇṇā kaliṅgā caritā vaṇijjā, vettācaro saṅkupathopi ciṇṇo;
segments.ja438:7.3: Naṭehi ciṇṇaṃ saha vākurehi [vākarehi (pī. sī. niyya), vāgurehi (?)], daṇḍena yuddhampi samajjamajjhe.
segments.ja438:8.1: Baddhā kulīkā [kuliṅkā (sī. pī.)] mitamāḷhakena, akkhā jitā [akkhācitā (sī. aṭṭha.)] saṃyamo abbhatīto;
segments.ja438:8.3: Abbāhitaṃ [appahitaṃ (sī. syā.), abbūhitaṃ (pī. sī. niyya)] pubbakaṃ [pupphakaṃ (sī. syā.)] aḍḍharattaṃ, hatthā daḍḍhā piṇḍapaṭiggahena.
segments.ja438:9.3: Yathā ayaṃ dissati lomapiṇḍo, gāvo hatā kiṃ pana daddarassāti.
segments.ja438:13.1: Varagijjha samajjana haṃsavaro, nidhisavhaya hārita pāṭaliko;
segments.ja438:13.3: Ajarāmara dhaṅka titikkha kuto, atha dvādasa pekkhana daddaribhīti.
